hints.title: Sort Packages and Boxes
hints.text: Sort packages once and sort each supplier box options in ascending order.

hints.title: Binary Search for Package Capacity
hints.text: Use binary search to find the number of newly fit packages covered by each increasing box size.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Package Subtraction
hints.text: Total wasted space equals sum of box_size * count_packaged minus the total sum of all package sizes.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

class Solution:
    def minWastedSpace(self, packages: list[int], boxes: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        packages.sort()
        n = len(packages)
        pkg_sum = sum(packages)
        INF = float('inf')
        min_total_box = INF

        for supplier in boxes:
            supplier.sort()
            if supplier[-1] < packages[-1]:
                continue
            curr_box_sum = 0
            prev_idx = 0
            for b in supplier:
                idx = bisect.bisect_right(packages, b)
                count = idx - prev_idx
                curr_box_sum += count * b
                prev_idx = idx
                if idx == n:
                    break
            min_total_box = min(min_total_box, curr_box_sum)

        return (min_total_box - pkg_sum) % (10**9 + 7) if min_total_box != INF else -1
```

complexity.time: O(n log n + B log n)
variables: B is total box options across suppliers
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through packages for each box size takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search queries on sorted packages compute covered quantities in logarithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks supplier box[-1] >= packages[-1] and subtracts package sum.
